en.question:
If <<5919>> declaring EARTH begins applying while <<14565>> is treated as both LIGHT and DARK Attribute due to its own effect, what happens?

Furthermore, what happens if <<14565>> is Xyz Summoned using a monster whose original Attribute is DARK while <<5919>> declaring EARTH is already applying, or if <<14565>>'s own effect attaches a DARK monster from the opponent's Graveyard to it while <<5919>> declaring EARTH is already applying?
en.title: What happens to <<14565>>'s Attributes if <<5919>> is applying?
